headline: Accepted January minutes, elected officers, and appointed subcommittee members for 2026
summary: The Library Trustees accepted the January 27, 2026 minutes, elected Kevin O'Reilly as Chair and Joanne Panunzio as Secretary, and appointed subcommittee members and chairs. The Library Director reported on the FY2026 and FY2027 budgets, building and vehicle issues, collections, community engagement, personnel changes, and upcoming programs. No other formal decisions were recorded.
decisions: Approved accepting the minutes of the January 27, 2026 meeting as amended, 9-0.
Approved nominating Kevin O'Reilly to serve as Chair of the Board of Trustees.
Approved nominating Joanne Panunzio to serve as Secretary of the Board of Trustees.
